title: Bound on the drop-value vector
statement: Let $n,p,z,s,u,f,q,t,a,B$ be natural numbers, each of $n,p,z,s,u,f,q,t,a$ at most $B$. Then every entry of the length-nine vector $(p,n,z,s,u,f,q,t,a)$ is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers n, p, z, s, u, f, q, t, a, and B
